pure-announcement.rationale: It is a product quickstart tutorial, not a launch, release note or funding announcement.

duplicate.rationale: None of the nearest concepts (research sandboxes, skills format, MCP governance) covers deploying or sharing Omnigent sessions.

unfalsifiable.rationale: The steps are reproducible against the named product and hosting provider.

durability.rationale: Railway deploy clicks, `omni login`/`omni host` commands and UI buttons are product-and-provider specifics that churn quickly; the only enduring line is that co-driving a shared session grants code execution on the host machine.

actionability.rationale: Entirely product-only steps, useful to an Omnigent user today but transferring nothing to anyone building or deciding outside that product.

atomicity.rationale: It bundles server deployment, phone access, session sharing and cloud sandbox hosts as a feature tour with no single core idea to state in a paragraph.
